findings.title: loop-evidence executes a shell command from an imported journal
findings.diagnosis: cmd/hma/loop.go:231 checks only that verify.argv exists. Lines 142–146 forward it to evidence.Capture. internal/evidence/capture.go:139 launches the resolved executable without refusing shell command mode. A minimal journal with a recomputed envelope digest therefore runs /bin/sh -c and gains durable evidence records. This violates architecture §§7.1 and 14. The original verify-loop interface rejects this argv. No stage advance, criterion credit, hostile same-UID activity, or forged receipt was needed. The capture-layer weakness existed before Gate C; the new Gate C entry point makes it reachable from imported journal input.

evidence.observation: Real CLI accepts /bin/sh -c, exits 0, creates shell-marker containing auditor-shell, and appends core evidence plus host loop_evidence. The initial setup attempt failed because the scratch store did not exist; it ran no check. Creating that scratch directory allowed the same CLI probe to reproduce the defect. All attempts remain logged.
verify-loop reject_unsafe_argv identifies the exact argv accepted by HMA as shell command string.
TestAuditorFinal4LoopRejectsShell logs error=<nil>, marker_exists=true, chains_unchanged=false and fails.

fix.action: Enforce a no-shell executable/argv policy in internal/evidence.Capture before cmd.Run, and apply the same check during loop-evidence admission. Resolve executable identity and reject shell command/script entry points, including supported platform shell aliases. Refuse before execution or either append. Keep the approved explicit check argv; do not turn an imported command string into authority.
fix.why: exec.Command avoids an implicit shell, but explicitly selecting /bin/sh still invokes one. The current existence-only check does not enforce the unwaivable contract.

verification.method: Run the saved TestAuditorFinal4LoopRejectsShell and shell-cli input against the repaired binary; include absolute shell paths, PATH aliases, symlinks, combined command flags and supported Windows shell equivalents.
verification.expected: Each shell input refuses before marker creation and before either chain changes.

verification.method: Run explicit Python/Go/executable checks with literal metacharacter arguments, nonzero exit, capped stdout/stderr, unchanged target, and a mutating-target negative control. Run repository tests/vet/race and host dogfood.
verification.expected: Approved non-shell checks still capture their actual exit/output; mutating checks refuse evidence append; existing authority guarantees stay intact.

fix.tradeoffs: Rejecting shell entry points breaks shell-based checks, including current Gate C output fixtures. Replace those fixtures with explicit executable argv. Executable classification is platform-specific. A denylist alone cannot prove that an arbitrary executable never starts a shell internally; preserve the trusted-host and approved-command boundary and state that limit.
fix.alternative: As immediate containment, disable loop-evidence execution and require existing approved non-shell capture commands until the shared executor guard is tested. An explicitly approved resolved-executable allowlist is a stronger but more restrictive host alternative.

prior_findings.title: A failed review can downgrade an existing blocker by ID
prior_findings.assessment: Snapshot strength tests cover BLOCK/WAIVABLE omissions and same-ID downgrade attempts under REQUEST_CHANGES and ESCALATE; approving control resolves exact own unit.

prior_findings.title: Imports accept stale core bindings and can erase newer blockers
prior_findings.assessment: Core head is checked at both imports. Auditor finding/criterion mutations and live tracked/untracked changes refuse without changing either chain; baseline route/waiver invalidation suites also pass.

prior_findings.title: Replaying an old passing run overrides a newer failed review
prior_findings.assessment: Two concurrent imports produce exactly one success. Newer unanswered packets invalidate the old approval. Existing replay-after-failure tests also pass.

prior_findings.title: Generated packets do not bind the observed repository artifact
prior_findings.assessment: Packet derives artifact from Snapshot; receipt root/launch fields and live target are checked. Wrong artifact/root and dirty-target controls in repository tests pass.

prior_findings.title: Final-audit reason does not enforce final-review family separation
prior_findings.assessment: Final issuing reason activates both provider-family and model-family separation independently of final_validation. Existing same-family controls pass.

prior_findings.title: Receipt import ignores provider and effort drift
prior_findings.assessment: Auditor wrong and missing provider, effort, model and agent cases refuse; exact-route control passes.

prior_findings.title: Invalid audit reports can approve and clear findings
prior_findings.assessment: Auditor valid control and missing target/requirements/evidence/findings, failed requirement, unfrozen and partial cases agree with Python and cannot clear BLOCK or open gate. Existing malformed/trailing/high-finding fixtures pass.

prior_findings.title: Unverified reference labels create new unwaivable blockers
prior_findings.assessment: Unsupported citations cannot create BLOCK/WAIVABLE. Positive reproduced-kernel and measured-budget paths are explicitly deferred by the accepted boundary.

prior_findings.title: The verify-loop evidence bridge is absent
prior_findings.assessment: The evidence bridge exists, retains journal/attempt links and streams, re-captures red then repaired checks and credits no criterion. C-F19 leaves its required no-shell guarantee open.

prior_findings.title: Review dispatches have no short validity interval
prior_findings.assessment: Auditor tests before issue, at issue, just before expiry, exactly at expiry and after expiry. Only [from,until) passes. Stale core/route controls cover rewind rejection.

prior_findings.title: Reviewer independence checks only the latest implementation
prior_findings.assessment: implementationContributions scans all implementation dispatches and direct decisions. Full suite multi-route independence control passes.

prior_findings.title: Reservation checks assigned to Gate C are not implemented
prior_findings.assessment: Accepted §0.1 retains reservation, namespace, replay, half-open expiry and generation tests at Gate D; no Gate C positive authority claim is accepted.

prior_findings.title: New legacy manual-review writes bypass the consolidated import path
prior_findings.assessment: Once packet mode begins, dispatch/manual-review entry points cannot supply imported provenance or override failures. Legacy history remains readable and mode is labelled.

prior_findings.title: Invalid audit reports approve, clear blockers, and satisfy the host Verification gate
prior_findings.assessment: Same evidence as F07. Invalid reports cannot clear the seeded blocker or open Verification; valid report plus snapshot does.

prior_findings.title: An old live-target review can clear a blocker after the worktree changes
prior_findings.assessment: Both imports re-snapshot the recorded target. Independent tracked/untracked drift checks refuse, preserve core findings and leave chains unchanged.

prior_findings.title: Finding namespace prefixes allow a review to clear another unit blocker
prior_findings.assessment: SnapshotFindings uses UnitID, not string prefixes. Slash-containing unit and finding identifiers preserve other-unit blockers in auditor assertions.

prior_findings.title: HMA-generated review packets omit the contract and findings snapshot
prior_findings.assessment: Current packet contains bound core head, plan digest, criteria projection, findings and waivers; exact core commit check prevents a stale assembled packet append. Full contract-dependent immutable inputs remain human-deferred.

prior_findings.title: Existing unprefixed core findings have no import migration
prior_findings.assessment: Legacy omitted ownership is assigned conservatively; unowned findings stay in force. Auditor other-unit and active-waiver projection checks pass; authentic approving own-unit legacy resolution passes in full suite.

prior_findings.title: Required disposition, criterion recheck and independent-credit integration are absent
prior_findings.assessment: Positive disposition reproduction, plan-budget checks and independent criterion credit require Gate D data and are human-deferred. Negative no-credit and unsupported-citation controls pass.

prior_findings.title: Gate C launch-reconciliation integration is deferred in full
prior_findings.assessment: Auditor/full suite wrong envelope/store checks fail closed; valid recapture succeeds. Namespace/reservation/generation reconciliation is human-deferred. This status does not claim that launch authority exists.

prior_findings.title: loop-evidence executes verify argv before checking terminal state
prior_findings.assessment: Closed and missing runs refuse before marker creation. An open capture holds the host lock; terminalization following the CLI lock order waits until capture finishes, then further captures refuse. Race probe passes without deadlock.

prior_findings.title: Legacy compatibility runs do not expose an enforcement-mode label
prior_findings.assessment: legacy_manual and packet_import are exposed by show --mode and normal host write results. Migration rejects new manual review approval.

prior_findings.title: A newer unanswered packet does not invalidate an older approving review
prior_findings.assessment: Auditor newer pending packet invalidates old snapshot/gate; completing the latest exact pass and snapshot reopens only the host gate. Concurrent double-import is tested under -race.

prior_findings.title: The fixed review packet still omits mandatory review inputs
prior_findings.assessment: Full request, criterion definitions, non-goals, budgets, required-evidence and policy bytes are explicitly human-deferred. Available packet inputs are core-head bound and current findings are present.

prior_findings.title: The broader Gate C acceptance-boundary deferral is not approved and leaves design requirements incomplete
prior_findings.assessment: Human scope decision is authoritative. Accepted §0.1 preserves the deferred rows and exit criteria. No reservation, criterion-credit or closure success is inferred.

prior_findings.title: Legacy dispatch input can impersonate an HMA-generated review packet
prior_findings.assessment: Auditor caller Packet injection is refused without append. The real HMA-generated packet/import/snapshot control passes; legacy packet/manual review cases in repository suite remain distinct.

prior_findings.title: Loop recapture discards the verification output
prior_findings.assessment: Auditor recapture retains distinct stdout/stderr, exit 7 and output above cap. The retained bytes reproduce the framed digest; truncation is explicit. Mutating-check negative control passes.

prior_findings.title: Go reads case-variant JSON keys that the Python contract ignores
prior_findings.assessment: UnmarshalExact discards case/fold variants before struct decoding. Auditor verdict/isolation/binding and route-field cases grant no authority; full Unicode receipt tests pass.

prior_findings.title: Go and Python disagree on required nonempty report fields
prior_findings.assessment: U+001C..U+001F invalid passes preserve blockers and close gate. Explicit full-code-point Python/Go whitespace parity executes and passes.

prior_findings.title: Interrupted output-artifact writes are trusted as complete on retry
prior_findings.assessment: Auditor empty, partial and symlink artifact residue refuses and remains unchanged; intact output artifact is reused. Temp-write/link implementation prevents partial bytes under the final name.

This is one auditor session using the route requested by the dispatch (liz / gpt-6.1-sol / high). The session cannot independently attest its serving provider/model/effort telemetry. No worker, nested agent CLI or model API was invoked.

Tests ran on a filesystem copy under this output directory. Production source bytes were copied unchanged; TODO.md, .serena/ and Gate D amendment inputs were omitted. Auditor tests and scratch Git fixtures exist only under the output directory. Repository access remained read-only.

Existing test helpers supply synthetic setup; auditor-authored assertions and the standalone real-CLI probe supply independent behavior checks. Prior named auditor source tests were not imported from other audit directories.

Fixtures use synthetic approvals explicitly labelled not human approvals. They prove command behavior, not authentic human authorization or provider identity. The host dogfood is synthetic and launches no worker.

The contract-valid verify-loop journal is synthetic and starts no worker. Gate D lease/admission/reservation/namespace authority and positive criterion credit are not implemented acceptance claims here.

Tests are adversarial samples, not proof of absence. No crash injection into the new output writer was performed; residue tests and static temp/sync/link inspection cover that writer. Existing crash/restart suites were executed.
No callable Jev tool was exposed. The auditor used the allowed orchestrator/human fallback. No advisory model is represented as Jev.

Some exploratory tool output was truncated. Mandatory report-contract, key source paths and relevant architecture sections were reread in bounded outputs. Raw test outputs are retained untruncated in log files.
